outcomes: An application composes plugins, child modules, dependency providers, and module hooks under one lifecycle owner
Startup makes dependency and configuration failures visible before the application reports ready
Shutdown runs cleanup in dependency-safe reverse order and reports every cleanup failure
Describe mode can collect deterministic build metadata without starting runtime workloads
A declared Domain Access & Replication Contract is enforced by the code that implements it, so a projection cannot serve a copy older than the bound its manifest promises
nonGoals: Defining HTTP, gRPC, storage, database, or event transport behavior
Restarting failed plugins or supervising a crashed process
Promising strict compatibility between every pre-1.0 minor release
Moving the data a DARC contract governs: the consumer supplies bootstrap and updates over whichever carrier the contract declares, and darc governs only what happens to them

requirements.text: Describe mode validates and configures a lazy dependency container, runs only describers, writes only below its output directory, and never starts runtime plugins. Build-triggered migration bundles use the authored project identity; programmatic describe calls retain the runtime application name.

The lifecycle runs module pre-configuration top-down, builds dependency injection, configures plugins, runs module post-configuration bottom-up, applies migrations, invokes functions, starts plugins, and then runs module start hooks top-down.
Shutdown runs module stop hooks bottom-up, stops plugins in reverse registration order, closes the dependency container, and aggregates cleanup errors.

Concurrent plugin start failures are aggregated before cleanup; a start timeout cancels sibling startup, waits a bounded interval for starters to drain, and avoids racing cleanup with a cooperative starter.

A reference refuses a fact its import does not name, and a registered darc component contributes exactly one describe-owned capability row per import and mode, carrying the declared contract verbatim in deterministic bytes. The row is evidence and never authority: emitting it cannot create a cross-domain permission.
